holdings.note: Pretend balance for a pretend wallet. In-world the claim is confirmable on-chain at the identity anchor; no keys exist because none are needed.

intents.story: Marcus first asked about coverage in the spring, before the quarry-road contract got renewed and life got loud. Nobody answered in ninety days and the want went stale — the fixture keeps it because a consumer MUST not mistake it for a live ask.

Marcus is on the road eleven months a year and keeps his savings where he can reach them from any truck stop. A wallet he can check from the cab is the point — he came back in November and asked again, and this time he means to see it through.
